title: TokenMintEvent
description: Immutable record of elohim-token minting. Every mint is coupled to a witnessed REA economic event — there is no free-floating token creation.

provenanceEventId.description: ID of the REA economic event that triggered this mint

mintTier.description: Whether this was a deterministic micro-mint or an elohim discernment mint

sourceEprId.description: Content ID of the EPR that this mint is coupled to

constitutionalContext.description: Governance layer under which this mint occurred

elohimAttestation.description: Elohim attestation hash (Tier 2 discernment mints only)
